title: CustomDomainCommon
description: Shared definitions for the customDomains registry (#1110) and the owner domain callables: hostnames, the lifecycle status, DNS instructions and the apex redirect. Launch policy: subdomains only, the apex forwarded by the registrar, IDN and punycode labels rejected.

servedHostname.description: The exact normalised host Catch serves: lowercase LDH labels, no trailing dot, port, wildcard or IP address, and at least one label below the registrable domain (launch serves subdomains only, such as www.myrunclub.com). Punycode (xn--) labels are rejected at launch.

registrableDomain.description: The registrable domain (public suffix plus one label, from the Public Suffix List, for example myrunclub.com or myrunclub.co.in) that the served host belongs to. Also the apex a registrar redirect forwards from.

cnameTarget.description: The Catch SaaS target the served host must CNAME to, on the dedicated neutral Cloudflare zone.

ownershipChallenge.description: The TXT value at _catch-verify.<hostname>. Fresh for every generation, kept published while the domain is live and rechecked by the reconciler.

status.description: pendingDns -> verified -> provisioning -> active <-> lapsed -> removed. Any state can move to suspended (admin) or failed (provider error, retryable to pendingDns). A pendingDns record whose lease ends becomes expired. removed and expired are terminal for a generation and do not block another reservation of the hostname.

generation.description: Increments on every new reservation of the hostname, so a stale probe, provider callback or client request cannot act on a newer lease.

type.description: CNAME and TXT are DNS records. redirect is a registrar URL-forwarding rule (apex to https://<served host>).

name.description: The record name, or the apex for a redirect.

value.description: The CNAME target, the TXT value or the https redirect destination.

purpose.description: routing points the served host at Catch; ownership is Catch's TXT challenge; certificate pre-validates the provider certificate before the CNAME flips; apexRedirect forwards the bare domain.

apexRedirect.description: How the bare domain reaches the served host: a registrar redirect at launch, or a CNAME-flattened second custom hostname that the edge 301s. Null when the served host is not www-style or the owner declined.

reviewState.description: none: auto-approved. held: a blocklist or lookalike near-match waits for Admin review and never serves. approved: an admin cleared a hold.
